tone.quote: These variations among Nyishi (Bengni) illustrate how vowel and suffixal differences are common across Tani groups, paralleling the situation in Tagin. Here the Nyishis of Bameng (East Kameng) has “o”as tone as compared to “a” of Nyishis of Chayangtajo (East Kameng), similarly even in Adi tribe, the Bokars of Shi-Yomi has “o” as a tone compared to “a” of other Adi sub tribes.
